applications.why: Windows Widgets is optional during a flight and can be closed for the session.
applications.msfsImpact: Live feeds and embedded web content can use background CPU, memory, and network resources.

applications.why: Samsung Magician monitoring is not required while the simulator is running.
applications.msfsImpact: Background drive monitoring may add occasional storage and CPU activity.

applications.why: Microsoft PC Manager background monitoring is optional during a flight.
applications.msfsImpact: Monitoring and cleanup checks can add occasional CPU and storage activity.

applications.why: The FS2Crew product manager is not required after installed products have launched.
applications.msfsImpact: Updater and product-management activity can use background network and storage resources.

applications.why: Windows system host used by packaged applications; it is protected from session stopping.
applications.msfsImpact: Leave running to avoid interrupting Windows and Microsoft Store application windows.

applications.why: Shared web component that may belong to another application currently in use.
applications.msfsImpact: Closing it may interrupt the application that owns the web view.

applications.why: Development or automation process whose current work may be interrupted if closed.
applications.msfsImpact: No known direct MSFS impact; leave running unless you know the task is no longer needed.

applications.why: Intel graphics monitoring component that may support active performance tools.
applications.msfsImpact: Usually low impact; closing it may interrupt graphics monitoring or telemetry.

services.why: Samsung Magician monitoring is not required while the simulator is running.
services.operationalNote: Background drive monitoring may add occasional storage and CPU activity; the service is restored after the flight.

services.why: Microsoft PC Manager background monitoring is optional during a flight.
services.operationalNote: Monitoring and cleanup checks can add occasional CPU and storage activity; the service is restored after the flight.

services.why: Microsoft Gaming Services supports Store and Xbox game licensing and online functionality.
services.operationalNote: Protected to avoid disrupting simulator authentication, online services, and live weather.

services.why: Tobii runtime service may be required by active eye-tracking or headset hardware.
services.operationalNote: Protected to avoid interrupting tracking and VR hardware features.

services.why: Intel graphics monitoring service may support active performance and graphics tools.
services.operationalNote: Usually low impact; stopping it may interrupt graphics monitoring or telemetry.

services.why: VPN tunnel service may be carrying the simulator's network connection.
services.operationalNote: Protected because stopping it can disconnect online services, multiplayer, and live weather.
